visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, dark wavy hair, wearing a mint green knitted vest over a light pink top, smiles vibrantly and waves both hands at the camera. She sits in a brightly lit indoor room with shelves behind her filled with various blue and white plush toys and organized items. (2) She presents a large, square display box featuring pastel blue and pink illustrations of cartoon pigs in costumes. She uses her hands to demonstrate the size of the box and points to the graphics, her facial expressions showing high excitement and joyful anticipation while maintaining an eye-level perspective. (3) The woman proceeds to open the main box, revealing several smaller individual blind boxes inside. She handles the packaging with quick, agile hand movements, tearing away the outer plastic and cardboard. Several yellow and white text overlays appear at the bottom center of the frame periodically. (4) She opens each small box and rips into a silver inner foil bag to reveal different plush pig characters. The reveals include a white plush pig, a pink bear-themed pig, and others in various pastel-colored outfits. She holds each one close to the camera for a detailed close-up of the soft fabric texture. (5) In the final sequence, the woman arranges all six revealed plushies—white, pink, light green, dark green, purple, and dark blue—inside the original display carton. She smiles and gestures toward the completed collection, which is then shown in a still-like group shot for a few seconds.
